influences.name: Prince
influences.context: It kind of came to me when Prince started putting out so many albums within a couple months that it had started to cheapen itself to me, when I had waited for a year after Sign 'O' The Times for Lovesexy.

influences.name: Parliament Funkadelic
influences.context: Up against The Beatles, Parliament Funkadelic has been my favorite band since I was a teenager. I started buying the Funkadelic records when they were still a quarter.

influences.name: The Beatles
influences.context: We were trying to go for a more Beatle-y thing. It's very melodic.

influences.name: Jethro Tull
influences.context: That's all of us, actually. We call it the 'regal factor', you know, Fairport Convention, Steel eye Span, Tull, even the more foul shit like Gentle Giant, ELP. We've listened to tons and tons of prog rock.
